name: app-lime-mobility-location-and-voice-booking
title: Held-phone location screen next to a glowing voice orb
whatItIs: Two panels: a low-angle photo of a person holding out a phone showing a dark map and 'Where to?' sheet with a lime Continue button; and a white panel with a soft glass orb of lime and black swirls labelled 'Listening.'
whatItMeans: Human and calm; the orb makes voice interaction feel alive, and the white panel contrasts with the energetic lime.
techniques: Show the UI held towards the viewer for a direct, confident presentation.
Design an AI-listening state as a single soft gradient orb on white.
Use a minimal caption and empty input to keep the voice state uncluttered.
Keep the accent colour consistent across photo and abstract panels.

vocabulary.definition: An animated shape signalling that a voice assistant is listening.
A photo where a device is pushed towards the camera.
A screen depicting one moment in a flow.
A translucent sphere with blurred colour inside.
